chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Muḥammad, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a free man engaging in liʿān with a bondwoman. He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الْحُرِّ: a free man, as opposed to a slave
key_terms.نَعَمْ: an affirmative legal response meaning yes
key_terms.يُلَاعِنُ: engages in liʿān, the mutual imprecation procedure

ai.seo_question: Can a free man perform liʿān with a bondwoman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a concise legal ruling that liʿān may take place involving a free man and a bondwoman. Its significance is in establishing a point of fiqh through a brief response from the Imam عليه السلام.
